scope: Two unapproved dimensional weapon payload source candidates for native moving prototype comparison.
A: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production-ready transparent PNG payload sprite for a premium portrait space game, not a concept sheet. Input images 1, 2 and 3 are MATERIAL, LIGHTING AND CAMERA STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: the game's approved cannon textures. Do not reproduce their cannon or any ship. Create exactly ONE heavy magnetic ion torpedo, oriented vertically with its physical armoured NOSE POINTING DOWN toward the bottom edge, rear at the top. Orthographic three-quarter/top-down rendering matching the reference barrels, with substantial visible thickness, clean bevels and self-occlusion. The payload is compact military machinery: dark chrome and black-violet ceramic segmented armour plates, deeply recessed seams, small machined fasteners, broad silver/cyan metallic reflections under the same cool upper-left light, and a few narrow hot violet/magenta recesses showing dense plasma INSIDE. Give it a strong blunt-tapered lower nose, layered shoulders and a small number of short asymmetric containment fins or brackets; keep a coherent engineered silhouette, no long wings or spaceship cockpit. A short dense irregular violet plasma wake may emerge ONLY from the upper rear, under 15 percent of total object length, with dark saturated shoulders and tiny white-hot detail. Preserve plentiful dark material; this must read as weighty ordnance, not a candy spiral, potion, glowing crystal, jewel or toy. Match the reference's glossy rendered material quality and precise hardware edges; no vector art or flat shapes. Composition: one entire centred sprite in a square frame, full silhouette plus short wake fits within the central 75–80 percent of canvas height and about 45–55 percent width; generous fully transparent margins. Nose direction must be straight screen DOWN, not left/right/up. True transparent background and usable clean alpha, no environment, floor, cast ground shadow, UI, lettering, diagrams, captions, swatches, borders, signature, watermark or duplicated parts. Output the actual finished standalone sprite, with all highlights and small emission attached to the metal, no scene or mockup.
B: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished standalone transparent PNG weapon payload sprite for a premium portrait space game, ready to animate as the actual raster asset, not a concept sheet. Input images 1, 2 and 3 are material, lighting and camera style references ONLY, the game's approved rendered cannons. Do not copy their gun shapes or add any ship. Create exactly ONE heavy irregular reactor-fragment warhead captured inside segmented GUNMETAL containment hardware. Camera is orthographic three-quarter/top-down matching the references; physical nose/firing direction is straight DOWN, rear is UP. The central mass is a DENSE BLACK-VIOLET irregular fractured industrial reactor chunk, not a polished gem: uneven chipped surfaces, heavy shadowed facets and narrow hot magenta/cyan cracks showing fierce energy deep INSIDE. Surround it with four to six SHORT thick asymmetric machined gunmetal/chrome containment brackets and broken ceramic armour segments, recessed seams, tiny fasteners, bevels and broad silver/cyan reflections, each visibly substantial with occlusion and weight. The lower edge/nose is angular and blunt-heavy; the top rear can have a VERY SHORT turbulent plasma leak. Keep it compact and oblong, subtly asymmetric, not a round hanging ornament, crystal ball, glass bottle, perfume bottle, potion, spinning top, bauble, gemstone, charm or floating jewel. No decorative jewellery rings, spiral stripes or candy. Metallic mass and dark material must dominate; emission occupies small cracks/inner gaps, with only tiny irregular white-hot accents and nonuniform falloff. Render with the references' cool upper-left highlights, rich purple-black shadows, precise glossy bevels and photorealistic-stylized game texture quality. Composition: entire single sprite centered in a square frame with nose down, clear fully transparent margins of at least12percent on every side; body plus short plasma leak occupies70–78percent of canvas height and50–65percent width. No cropped fins or glow. True transparent background with clean usable alpha, no backdrop, environment, ground, floor shadow, UI, labels, captions, text, diagrams, border, signature, watermark or duplicated sprite. This is solid dangerous ordnance with a contained hot core, not a pretty luminous object.
